newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid panic selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid panic selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks dipped more than three percent at the close on Monday as panicky punters, desperate to escape from a falling market, maintained selling pressure, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) fell 91.26 points or 3.02 percent at 2,921.7 on turnover of 43 million taka. Of 92 traded issues, 88 lost and four gained.
"Fund crisis still prevails. Small investors have become a bit panicky. They are desperate to aviod further losses in a falling market," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.
Monno Fabrics was the volume leader with 41,350 scrips traded up 12.25 taka at 257. Square Pharma lost 91 to 1,755.
